prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Charles MO for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one lender that’s best for every buyer—your rate and fees depend on your credit, down payment, loan type, and timing. **First State Bank Mortgage** looks like a strong local starting point: it has St. Charles mortgage offices and offers purchase loans. Its online review profile shows a high rating, though reviews alone don’t tell you whether its loan offer is competitive.

I’d get written Loan Estimates from **First State Bank**, **Guild Mortgage’s St. Charles branch**, and one other lender such as **UMB** or a credit union. Compare the same loan type, down payment, and rate-lock period, focusing on the **APR, lender fees, points, and estimated cash to close**—not just the advertised rate. Ask each lender about closing timelines and any first-time-buyer or down-payment-assistance programs you may qualify for.

Local options: [First State Bank Mortgage](https://fsbfinancial.com/about-us/locations/2850-west-clay-street/), [Guild Mortgage](https://branches.guildmortgage.com/mo/weldonspring/st-charles-158.html), and [UMB](https://locations.umb.com/mo/saintcharles/umb-mortgage-loan-services-540m.html).
